thought.text: Token valid as `@alex:localhost`. Now let me verify the room and message content, plus tom's account.

reasoning_content:
The alex token works — `@alex:localhost`. Next, verify the following:
1. tom's token
2. Rooms and messages (message sending/receiving as stated in the guide)
3. A new end-to-end SSO login (to prove that SSO is functioning at this point, not just from a token)

Let's check the rooms and message content.

action.command: TOM_TOKEN=$(cat /tmp/nebu-bootstrap/tom_token.txt); echo "=== tom whoami ==="; curl -sS -m 10 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOM_TOKEN" http://localhost:8008/_matrix/client/v3/account/whoami -w '\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n'; ROOM=$(cat /tmp/nebu-bootstrap/alex_room.txt); echo "room=$ROOM"; ENC=$(python3 -c "import urllib.parse;print(urllib.parse.quote('!fecb8580371b5f46:localhost',safe=''))"); ALEX_TOKEN=$(cat /tmp/nebu-bootstrap/alex_token.txt); echo "=== room state ==="; curl -sS -m 10 -H "Authorization: Bearer $ALEX_TOKEN" "http://localhost:8008/_matrix/client/v3/rooms/$ENC/state" | python3 -m json.tool | head -30; echo "=== messages (alex view) ==="; curl -sS -m 10 -H "Authorization: Bearer $ALEX_TOKEN" "http://localhost:8008/_matrix/client/v3/rooms/$ENC/messages?dir=b&limit=10" | python3 -m json.tool | head -60
